scope: vehicle graphics microtask: source-backed wheel proportion and axle fitment
critical_findings: The previous runtime-rig upgrader estimated tyre radius from the absolute Y coordinate of the four recovered axle anchors and clamped that estimate to 0.30-0.45 m. Axle-anchor height is not tyre-size provenance and can visibly distort otherwise-correct recovered cars.

ToyotaMark2 is the strongest current fitment repair target because its identity/body/interior/rig evidence is strong and its wheelbase is already effectively correct, while the current conversion loses the source rear-track stagger and uses oversized shared wheel geometry.

Exact stock fitment metadata already exists in the lane, so the runtime-rig step can apply source-backed front/rear radii, widths, tracks and axle spacing without guessing body origin or silently claiming fallback tyre art is recovered source art.

representative_target.next_visual_gate: recover exact stock cap/tyre geometry, rebuild with this fitment path, render close/mid/far, then re-grade

grade_after_tooling_fix.reason: The proportion/placement path is now source-backed and SHA-locked, but temporary tyre geometry is still fallback art and cannot satisfy hero-vehicle wheel fidelity.
